loop_policy: Loop true ONLY for IDs 01-05 and 12; no pitch sweeps on loops

sound_effects.label: Idle
sound_effects.text: Seamless loop, small chunky cartoon hot-rod engine idling at a steady low RPM, lumpy and friendly, slight rattle of loose parts, dry close-mic, constant pitch, no revving, no music, no ambience

sound_effects.label: Low
sound_effects.text: Seamless loop, the same small chunky cartoon hot-rod engine at a steady low-mid RPM under light throttle, constant pitch, dry close-mic, no revving, no music

sound_effects.label: Mid
sound_effects.text: Seamless loop, the same small chunky cartoon hot-rod engine at a steady mid RPM under full load, punchy exhaust, constant pitch, dry close-mic, no revving, no music

sound_effects.label: High
sound_effects.text: Seamless loop, the same small chunky cartoon hot-rod engine at a steady high RPM under full load, buzzy and slightly strained, constant pitch, dry close-mic, no music

sound_effects.label: Coast
sound_effects.text: Seamless loop, the same small chunky cartoon hot-rod engine coasting off throttle at mid RPM, burbling overrun, constant pitch, dry close-mic, no music

sound_effects.label: Backfire
sound_effects.text: single cartoon exhaust backfire pop with a tiny crackle tail, dry, isolated

sound_effects.label: Shift
sound_effects.text: quick mechanical gear shift clunk of a cartoon toy car, short, dry, isolated

sound_effects.label: Boost
sound_effects.text: short airy whoosh of a cartoon turbo boost kicking in, rising, isolated

sound_effects.label: Landing
sound_effects.text: soft rubbery bounce thud of a toy car landing on soft clay ground, springy, isolated

sound_effects.label: Wall bump
sound_effects.text: cartoon car bonking into a wall, squishy clay impact with a short springy boing tail, isolated

sound_effects.label: Drift start
sound_effects.text: short cartoon tire squeal starting a drift on asphalt, dry, isolated

sound_effects.label: Hover
sound_effects.text: Seamless loop, soft humming antigrav hover engine, steady and warm, slight wobble, constant pitch, no music
